# muxt parses every template html/template parses. A '<' that does not
# start a tag is text, and a tag with an action or comment in its tag name
# or attribute names is text with actions: muxt generates and checks the
# template, and reports errors in those actions where html/template would.

muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
stdout 'wrote template_routes.go: 1 route'
muxt check
stdout 'ok: 1 template'
! stderr .

cp bad-template.gohtml template.gohtml
! muxt check
cmpenv stderr want-err.txt

-- template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>1 < 2</p>
<p>I <3 templates</p>
<p>back <- here</p>
<{{.Result.Tag}}>tag</{{.Result.Tag}}>
<h{{.Result.N}}>heading</h{{.Result.N}}>
<div data-{{.Result.Name}}="x">attribute name</div>
<div {{/* c */}} class="a">comment in tag</div>
<div class="b" {{- /* why */ -}}>trimmed comment in tag</div>
<p>unclosed end tag</p
{{if .Result.N}}<!-- {{end}} -->
<!-- {{if .Result.N}} -->x{{end}}
{{if .Result.N}}<!--{{else}}-->{{end}}
{{if .Result.N}}<!{{end}}>
{{template "raw text" .Result}}
{{end}}
{{define "raw text"}}<script>{{/* c */}}var n = {{.N}};</script
{{end}}
-- bad-template.gohtml --
{{define "GET / Index()"}}
<p>{{.Result.N}} < 2</p>
<{{.Result.Missing}}>tag</{{.Result.Tag}}>
<h{{.Result.Nope}}>heading</h{{.Result.N}}>
<div data-{{.Result.Gone}}="x" {{/* c */}} class="{{.Result.Lost}}">a < b</div>
<p>a <! b {{.Result.Bang}}</p>
<p>a <? b {{.Result.Query}}</p>
<p>a <!x {{.Result.Bogus}}> b</p>
{{end}}

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.22
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var source embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(source, "*"))

type T struct{}

type Data struct {
	Tag  string
	N    int
	Name string
}

func (T) Index() Data { return Data{} }
